hooks.name: Copy tone check
hooks.description: When src/core/copy.ts, any src/**/index.html or any docs/demo/**/*.html is saved, check every user-facing string against the Copy rules in the design steering file (and the demo-page rules for demo pages) and list violations.

action.prompt: A file with user-facing text was just saved: src/core/copy.ts, an index.html under src/, or a demo page under docs/demo/. Read the saved file and the "Copy" section of .kiro/steering/design.md. Check every user-facing string in the saved file (button labels, headings, paragraphs, help lines, placeholders, titles, aria-labels, toasts, error messages, empty states, table cells; not code comments, ids, class names or URLs) against these rules: English only; plain and literal; no exclamation marks; no puns on death or RIP; no memes or emoji; never address the reader in the extension's own UI (no "you", "your", "we'll"; ordinary page text on a demo page may); one line for empty states; the exact wording the steering file fixes (tagline, "Nothing has died here yet. Give it time.", "No grave bears that name.", "Clear search", the toasts, "≈ … freed (estimated)"). For a demo page under docs/demo/, also check design/demo-pages.md: the <title> and <meta name="description"> match its table exactly, the footer reads "Demo page for Rest in Tabs. Not a real shop or service.", no real company, product or person is named (Edgar Allan Poe excepted), and there are no scripts or external URLs. List each violation as: file, line, the string, the rule it breaks, and a suggested plain rewrite. If there are none, say "Copy check: no violations" with the number of strings checked. Do not edit the file; only report.
